references.role: Painting, lighting, full-body framing and charcoal backdrop ONLY; do not copy this person's face, clothing, anatomy or equipment

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single full-body portrait for a fictional tabletop game's Bestiary. Naturalistic HAND-PAINTED illustration, matching the supplied painting reference's grounded proportions, restrained brushwork and empty dark charcoal subtly painted backdrop. Soft neutral upper-left illumination, muted earthy palette, a small diffuse contact shadow only. Broad, calm light-to-shadow gradients on large surfaces; detail is selective at the face, silhouette and a few functional seams. Large folds and local damage rather than a uniform cracked-paint mesh or high-frequency surface noise. Entire subject, every foot, appendage, tool tip and tail comfortably inside a vertical 4:5 portrait with about 6% breathing room. No scenery, captions, letters, logos, frame, base disc or circular crop. A neutral standing/display pose, no combat scene, target, victim, blood or gore. Any style-only human reference supplies painting and lighting ONLY, never its person, clothes, weapons or anatomy.
Create a FRESH design from the written Neuroshima description, not from the rejected monochrome portrait. One stooped, very thin elderly HUMAN-looking man. A kind, familiar-looking old face with a gentle inviting expression, sunken cheeks and grey wispy hair; his frailty inspires sympathy. A little hunched in the shoulders, one hand extended in a modest asking/beckoning gesture, the other relaxed. Mismatched layers of ordinary worn clothes: loose faded olive overcoat, brown cardigan, frayed beige shirt, dark baggy trousers and worn unequal shoes. Large readable cloth folds, only a few actual tears at hems. Show the ENTIRE figure including both shoes. Plausible human hands with five digits and slightly long natural nails; no dramatic monster claws. He leads and lures a mutant pack, but looks like an ordinary pitiable old wanderer, not a demon, zombie, heroic wizard or fantasy beggar costume. No staff, armour, weapon, magic glow or other creature. Use colour and the shared painterly charcoal background.
